import math

# Step 1: Calculate C(53, 13) = 53! / (13! * 40!)
n = 53
k = 13

# Using the math.comb function for binomial coefficient
binomial_coeff = math.comb(n, k)
print(f"C(53, 13) = {binomial_coeff}")

# Step 2: Get the decimal digits and sum them
digits_str = str(binomial_coeff)
print(f"Decimal representation: {digits_str}")

# Convert each digit to an integer and sum
digit_sum = sum(int(d) for d in digits_str)
print(f"Individual digits: {[int(d) for d in digits_str]}")
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")

import math

# Verify using factorial definition
n = 53
k = 13

# Method 1: Using math.comb
result1 = math.comb(n, k)

# Method 2: Using factorial definition
result2 = math.factorial(n) // (math.factorial(k) * math.factorial(n - k))

print(f"Using math.comb: {result1}")
print(f"Using factorial formula: {result2}")
print(f"Both methods agree: {result1 == result2}")

# Calculate digit sum
digit_string = str(result1)
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in digit_string)

print(f"\nC(53, 13) = {result1}")
print(f"Number of digits: {len(digit_string)}")
print(f"Sum of decimal digits: {digit_sum}")
